name: Horatio
message: Yesterday I spilled all my secrets to you, my Queen. Are you going to return the favor?

name: Queen Gertrude
message: Hmm. You want to know about me?

name: Horatio
message: Is that so surprising?

name: Queen Gertrude
message: N-no, it's just... I've never been asked before. Hmm, where to begin...

name: Queen Gertrude
message: When I was a girl in Bohemia, my father the Emperor once told me I would be one of the most powerful women in the world.

name: Queen Gertrude
message: And he was right. He sent me here to Denmark when I was just a girl. I grew up here, between Copenhagen and Elsinore, betrothed to Hamlet's father.

name: Queen Gertrude
message: I followed Hamlet everywhere. He was all I knew, for a time. The only friend I had. He, and Claudius, his brother, and my elder sister Margaret.

name: Queen Gertrude
message: My elder sister Margaret stayed behind in Austria. She's very powerful now, with land all to her own, and armies at her beckon...

name: Queen Gertrude
message: I suppose this is... all a very different life from the one you've lived. I hope I'm not offending.

name: Horatio
message: On the contrary, I find it very interesting.

name: Horatio
message: What became of your sister Margaret? Do you speak to her still?

name: Queen Gertrude
message: Margaret was everything to me when we were young. I loved her more than life itself.

name: Queen Gertrude
message: When I came to Elsinore... I wrote her letters every day. And she wrote back, sometimes.

name: Queen Gertrude
message: But it was always to encourage me to cease contact, to study more, to love my new country and forget Austria entirely.

name: Queen Gertrude
message: Eventually, she stopped responding entirely. And I haven't seen her since.

name: Queen Gertrude
message: I missed her. I still dream of her sometimes—of us, playing as children again.

name: Horatio
message: I'm so sorry, my lady.

name: Horatio
message: How perfectly awful. I've never had siblings, but I can imagine.

name: Queen Gertrude
message: It is no matter. All the love I had for Margaret, I have poured into my husband and son. I hope they have appreciated it.

name: Queen Gertrude
message: Apologies, but I must go.

name: Horatio
message: Understood. See you tomorrrow.
